problem: validate_bounds is overridden as a no-op, dropping the 'unbounded end must be open' check, so inputs like (None, 5, True, True) are accepted and produce closed-infinity intervals that main rejected with ValueError.

Coercing 4-tuple flags with bool() before delegating removes the 'closed flags must be bool' check, so malformed flags like 'False', 'no' or None are silently reinterpreted as a different valid interval instead of raising ValueError.

The production module now depends on the private _Algebra in reference_impl and calls its parse as an unbound function on a non-subclass instance, while the rest of the file remains a full copy; this hidden coupling is what masks F1 and F2.
